correctness.rationale: Headline claim: disjoint union of K(60,3) on (X1,Y1) and K(3,60) on (X2,Y2) is a C8-free balanced (63,63) graph with 360 edges, so z(63,63;C8)>=360>189 and the admitted e(G)<=189 universal bound is false. Verified independently from witness_edgelist.txt: 360 unique edges, left set exactly 0-62, right set exactly 63-125, block decomposition exactly (0-59)x(63-65) union (60-62)x(66-125) with 180+180 edges. Structural proof is complete and needs no search: a cycle in K(a,b) alternates sides so has length at most 2*min(a,b)=6<8 per block; a subgraph C8 is connected so lies in one component, hence no (subgraph or induced) C8 exists. Cycle census formula C(m,k)C(n,k)k!(k-1)!/2 gives per-block #C4=5310, #C6=205320, #C8=0, totals 10620/410640/0, confirmed by independent from-scratch DFS from all 126 starts: directed C8=0, directed C6=4927680=410640*12 exactly. Block-family DP optimum verified as 360, so witness is best in that family. Machine scripts are corroboration only; proof does not depend on float arithmetic or search completeness. DRAFT honestly limits claim to lower bound >=360, exact z left open.

Substantive comparison to nearest priors: Bukh-Jiang (1403.1601) and He (2009.04590) are purely asymptotic ex(n,C2k) upper bounds with no balanced (63,63) window; Lazebnik-Ustimenko-Woldar CD graphs give asymptotic dense high-girth constructions only; Tait-Timmons (1601.05058) gives Omega(q^3/2) lower bounds plus conjecture (order of magnitude only); Peng-Tait-Timmons gives chi(ER_q) upper bounds; Godsil-Newman and Mattheus-Pavese-Storme give eigenvalue-order bounds. None states, implies, or tabulates z(63,63;C8)>=360 or a refutation of the 189 bound, and no surveyed source pairs K(60,3)+K(3,60) arithmetic with this window. Construction is elementary but its deployment as a window refutation is new relative to the admission record.
